purpose: Closes §F196's flagged loose end: §F193's relabeled-run headline numbers (41x/67-69x/68-75x chance) were measured at n=120 smoke scale. This rescores the same checkpoint family at the full n=580 scale for a like-for-like comparison against the n=580 baseline anchor (§F152/§F193) and the n=580 ablation (§F196).
injection_gate: PASSED (real vs noinj unique-ratio gap 20.57x) -- run before any other number here was trusted, per the mandatory gate adopted this session (scripts/injection_sanity_gate.py).
reading: Both metric families agree and both are far larger, in relative terms, than the n=120 smoke-scale numbers: tf-idf top-1 grows 156x -> 283x -> 318x chance across steps 5000/10000/14000 (worst-case p=0.0003, the permutation floor, at every step); semantic top-1 grows 143x -> 249x -> 277x chance over the same steps (same p-floor). The shuffle control at step 14000 collapses cleanly to exactly chance on both metrics (tfidf 0.0x p=1.0, semantic 1.0x p=0.64). No-injection reproduces the expected degenerate 1/24-unique collapse. This is now a full-scale, like-for-like confirmation of §F193's relabel effect, not merely a smoke-scale one.
